questions.cardText:
[Law] What is a tort?
A. A criminal act punishable by law
B. A breach of contract between two parties
C. A civil wrong causing harm or loss, leading to legal liability
Answer: C. The primary purpose of tort law is to provide remedies to individuals who have suffered harm by awarding them compensation for their losses. It also deters others from doing harm.
questions.en: In common law, what is the term for a civil wrong, other than a breach of contract, that causes someone harm or loss and leads to legal liability?
questions.de: Wie heißt im Common Law ein zivilrechtliches Unrecht, das kein Vertragsbruch ist, jemandem Schaden oder Verlust zufügt und zur Haftung führt?

timeline.labelEn: Beaulieu v Finglam: early English tort case imposing strict liability for a spreading fire
timeline.labelDe: Beaulieu v Finglam: früher englischer Deliktsfall mit Gefährdungshaftung für ein übergreifendes Feuer

questions.notes: German law calls the equivalent an 'unerlaubte Handlung' (Delikt); accept those in German.

questions.cardText:
[History] What was the bikini named after?
A. A fashion designer
B. A tropical fish
C. An island
Answer: C. Louis Réard named the bikini after the Bikini Atoll to signify that his new swimsuit would create an explosive reaction, similar to the impact of the atomic tests on the Bikini Atoll.
questions.en: After which Pacific atoll, site of atomic bomb tests in 1946, did Louis Réard name his new two-piece swimsuit?
questions.de: Nach welchem Pazifikatoll, Schauplatz von Atombombentests im Jahr 1946, benannte Louis Réard seinen neuen zweiteiligen Badeanzug?

timeline.labelEn: Louis Réard presents the bikini in Paris
timeline.labelDe: Louis Réard stellt in Paris den Bikini vor

questions.notes: Réard never explained the name himself; the 'explosive reaction' motive is the commonly attributed one.
